name: lowlamp-field-log
description: Lowlamp Field Log: a night-first observing log with an eyepiece sketch circle, an offline sync journal and certificate packets.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && rm -rf dist && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.mjs && esbuild src/client/main.tsx --bundle --minify --external:/fonts/* --target=es2022 --outdir=dist/public --entry-names=app && esbuild src/client/sw.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/public/sw.js && cp -R public/. dist/public/
